  (AUTH: forward = imports the (auth) snippet; oidc = Authelia, app does OIDC itself; external = authenticated outside Authelia (app login / token / edge); (portal) = this service IS the auth provider; change with 'hemma update service <name> --auth-mode <mode>')
  (LOCAL/PUBLIC: the auth.policy each horizon requires — bypass, one_factor, two_factor or deny; unset = one_factor; - = no policy, since only 'forward' and 'oidc' carry one (oidc has no bypass). PUBLIC is shown even when TUNNEL is no: the policy is declared, it just never fires from the internet)
  (TUNNEL: yes = a cloudflared tunnel ingress entry is generated for the FQDN, so the internet can reach it; no = local horizon only)
